Home Gold Exchange

How Gold Exchange Works Here — Without the Retail Trap

At jewellery showrooms, 'exchange' usually means your old gold's value is locked into buying new jewellery from the same shop — often with fresh making charges of 10–30% added on top, and an exchange valuation you never get to verify. The exchange rate looks generous until the bill arrives. Our service removes the lock-in: we are a gold buyer, not a jewellery retailer, so your old gold is valued openly and paid to you in money. Take that money to any jeweller, any brand, or nowhere at all — the value is yours, in full, with no purchase condition attached.

The valuation itself is the same transparent process as every sale here: XRF purity on screen, certified weighing in front of you, the day's live rate, and the calculation explained line by line. Because several old pieces can be tested and totalled together, families often exchange a whole collection — old bangles, a broken chain, single earrings — in one visit, and receive one clear figure and one instant payment with a proper invoice.

One honest clarification: exchange value is the metal value of your gold, as with any sale — original making charges and showroom markup are not recoverable, here or anywhere else. What you gain versus a showroom exchange is freedom: no forced purchase, no new making charges eating your value, and a number you watched being calculated. If part of your gold is pledged against a loan, we can release it first and then exchange the full piece.

How It Works

From Testing to Payment in 10–15 Minutes

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.
